brief: Counts the items of a list: by condition, by type, by value, and empty or not, and inserts around the items that meet a condition.
detail: Build one with new stzListCounter(aList) or over a stzList object; it keeps its own copy, so what you passed in is never changed. A condition is written in the W notation, a text in braces where @item stands for the item under test, such as '{ @item > 5 }'. Count compares texts case-sensitively; CountCS takes a 0 or 1 flag. The insertion methods InsertAfterW and InsertBeforeW change the list the counter holds. The question forms HowManyItemsW, HowManyUniqueItemsW and the alias InsertAfterWhere raise error R24 today; see their warnings.
